Bash(git -c commit.gpgsign=false commit -m "refactor\(theme\): centralize colors behind semantic CSS variables \(no visual change\)" -m "Phase 1 of the warm-ivory reskin \(see RESTYLE.md\). Tailwind tokens now resolve to CSS variables on :root; opacity modifiers continue to compose alpha via parallel -rgb triplets. Inline component hexes swapped for var\(--brand/--accent/--wa-1\) etc. Hex values remain == the prior lavender palette so the site renders identically." -m "Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 <noreply@anthropic.com>")

Bash(git -c commit.gpgsign=false commit -m "feat\(theme\): warm ivory + ink + gold palette" -m "Phase 2 of the reskin \(see RESTYLE.md §4\). Only the :root token block changes value to swap the whole site to warm ivory ground, espresso ink for text/primary buttons, and a single restrained gold accent. Backdrop blur dropped from .card / .glass / .glass-strong, colored glow shadows removed from buttons + .glow-hover, body multi-gradient replaced with one subtle warm wash, paper grain disabled on mobile. New .gold-text component class added with a graceful fallback. Razorpay theme + PWA themeColor + invoice PDF brand RGB aligned to the new palette. lavender-pastel Tailwind alias points at --accent-strong \(deep gold, AA on ivory\) so small-text links stay readable." -m "Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 <noreply@anthropic.com>")

Bash(git -c commit.gpgsign=false commit -m "feat\(hero\): merge HeroSlideshow + Hero into one full-bleed editorial hero" -m "Phase 3 of the reskin \(see RESTYLE.md §5\). The home page no longer stacks a framed slideshow over a centred Hero text block; instead the slideshow runs full-bleed at 100svh behind a single warm-ink scrim, with the static brand promise \(\\"Premium Handcrafted Art for Your Home\\"\) and the primary Explore Collections + secondary Or order a custom piece CTAs overlaid. Trust strip, framer-motion staggered reveal, autoplay+pause control, reduce-motion handling, swipe and dots all preserved. Hero.tsx deleted. Mobile motion trim: float / glow-pulse / slow-zoom / gentle-rotate are silenced under 769px to free paint budget for the LCP image." -m "Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 <noreply@anthropic.com>")

Bash(git -c commit.gpgsign=false commit -m "perf\(theme\): drop heavy backdrop-blur from dark nav surfaces + scrub remaining purple rgbas" -m "Phase 4 QA cleanup. Per RESTYLE.md §6 perf budget, removed backdrop-filter blur\(\) from BottomTabBar, MobileDrawer \(two layers\), SearchOverlay, StickyCartBar, CategoryChips, and the ProductCard heart chip - they were the eight components the brief flagged as the biggest mobile paint cost. Bumped the underlying bg opacity so the dark nav surfaces stay opaque enough without the blur. Also: header at scroll=0 promoted to bg-plum/85 \(was 40 + blur\) so ink glyphs stay readable; added a top-down ink scrim to the hero so the header has a dark backing while the user is still at the top; replaced the remaining lavender rgbas in ContactCTA, OurStoryTeaser, SectionDivider, and the MobileDrawer logo glow with gold / ink-toned equivalents." -m "Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 <noreply@anthropic.com>")
